ShortDescription.Value: Remembers tool panel settings per savegame (draw mode, snap, height...) with configurable sharing scope. 工具面板设置模式自动记忆

LongDescription.Value:
## **English**
Tired of redoing the same tool options every time you enter a save? **Tool Mode Memory** remembers how you left the tool panel — draw mode, snapping, parallel roads, height, placement modes and more — and brings those choices back when you return.
Every savegame gets its own memory file. Leave a save, come back later, and your setup is still there.
**Sharing scope** is configurable per tool item:
- Same group (e.g. all small roads) - Same menu (roads, education, ...) - Same asset type (alley, metro track, ...) - Shared globally - Per asset (not shared)
Turn the master switch **off** for 100% vanilla behaviour. Memory management (reset / open folder) and links live on the About tab.
## **中文**
每次进档都要把工具选项重设一遍？**Tool Mode Memory** 会记住你离开时的工具选项——绘制模式、吸附、平行道路、高度、放置模式等——下次进入该存档自动恢复。
每个存档单独一份记忆，退出覆盖保存。
**共用范围**可按工具项配置：同组 / 同菜单 / 同类资产 / 全局共用 / 全局不共用。
总开关关闭 = 完全原版行为。重置记忆、打开记忆文件夹与链接在「关于」页。

PublishConfiguration.ChangeLog:
v0.1.2
Fixed: memory could be written to the WRONG savegame. Starting a new city, or loading another save from the list, reused the name of the city you last saved with - so it restored that one's settings and then overwrote its memory file. Autosave could also take over the file name. This is now verified against the save actually loaded.
- "Same menu" scope now really covers the whole menu (it behaved like "Same group"). - Memory no longer breaks after adding or removing DLC / workshop assets. - Water tool memory now works. - Removed the Terrain and Upgrade items: those tools have nothing to remember (their "mode" is simply the asset you picked). - Settings now save immediately instead of only on a clean game exit. - Corrupted memory files are left alone instead of being overwritten.
Note: after updating, the first visit to each save starts empty once - the old records used a format that could not be carried over.
中文
修复：记忆可能写到错误的存档上。新建城市、或从存档列表载入另一个档时，会沿用你 上一次保存过的那个档的名字，于是不但恢复了别人的设置，还会把别人的记忆文件覆盖掉； 自动存档也会把文件名抢走。现在以真正载入的存档为准。
- 「同菜单」范围现在真的按整个菜单共用（以前等同于「同组」）。 - 加装 / 移除 DLC、创意工坊资产后记忆不再错乱。 - 水体工具的记忆现在生效。 - 移除「地形」「升级」两项：这两个工具没有可记的面板状态（所谓模式就是你选的资产本身）。 - 设置改为即时保存，不再只在正常退出时落盘。 - 记忆文件损坏时不再被覆盖，保留原件供手工修复。
提示：更新后每个存档第一次进入会是空记忆（一次性的），旧记录用的键格式无法沿用。
